risk_summary: The excerpt reports strong 2021 revenue, earnings, pricing, and fleet-cost improvements, creating a generally confident tone. However, operational performance remains exposed to COVID-19 variants, travel restrictions, inflation, semiconductor-driven fleet constraints, and uncertain demand, with several risks described qualitatively rather than quantified. Extensive non-GAAP adjustments and dense legal/accounting disclosures may complicate comparability and risk assessment.
